results.rationale: Consistency: The gray fluted column style and plain background remain, but surviving columns have altered proportions and shading, and the row spacing changes markedly to leave a large first gap; the background also becomes brighter. Instruction: Eight columns become six. A correct edit would show exactly five; reducing the count addresses the request but leaves one excess column, so compliance is partial. Quality: Structural coherence ✔, natural rendering ✔, artifact-free ✔, surface fidelity ✔; the six columns have clean capitals, shafts and bases with coherent shading.

Consistency: The white background and general clear dish setting remain, but the dish rim and radial grooves are noticeably redesigned, and the remaining apple has a rounder outline, smoother skin and different stem/highlights than the source central apple. Instruction: Six apples become one central red apple. Exactly one apple on the dish is the expected result, and the count change is fully achieved. Quality: Structure ✔, lighting ✔ and texture ✔; the apple and dish read clearly, with a minor artifact cluster of stray dark and pale marks below the lower dish edge (artifact-free ✘).
